result.summary: Implemented PRM-06/07/08/09 per design. Created 2 migrations (per-tenant promotion_assertion_runs with UNIQUE(tenant_id, idempotency_key) and conditional FK to promotion_reviews via to_regclass; global solution_pack_installs / solution_pack_artefact_bases / pack_update_resolutions). Created 7 Zig modules under src/definition/ (assertion_rerun, sandbox_pool, fixture_loader, rollback, pack_update) and src/api/routes/ (promotion_assertion, definition_rollback). All SQL parameterised (no string interpolation); all SQL using bare 'tenant' qualifier. PRM-07 sandbox teardown uses a single defer release() covering normal/error/panic paths; teardown failure records status='teardown_failed' via recordTeardownFailure(). PRM-06 idempotency via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. PRM-08 rollback performs version-pointer swap + DEFINITION_VERSION_ROLLED_BACK event append + promotion_reviews supersession in a single transaction. PRM-09 three-way diff classifies into unchanged/clean_update/local_only/conflict per the design. Route handlers map RunStatus.failed -> 422, RunStatus.passed/teardown_failed -> 200, SandboxUnavailable/PoolExhausted -> 503. src/bpm.zig extended to re-export the new modules (single-owner module rule). NO existing files in 'Files NOT to change' list were modified: src/definition/promotion.zig, src/definition/promotion_plan.zig, src/api/routes/promotion.zig, src/api/routes/promotions.zig, src/effects/stub.zig, src/event_store/store.zig, and migrations <=1155 untouched.
artifacts_out: src/bpm.zig (8 lines added — re-export shim only; no domain logic changed)
